preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)
rewardsPool address must be set (via setRewardsPool)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the rebase() function with a large multiple value (e.g., type(uint256).max / currentRebaseMultiple + 1) to cause an overflow in calculations. This will make all token transfers fail because the multiplication amount * rebaseMultiple in transfer() and transferFrom() will overflow, causing transactions to revert. The attack permanently bricks the token functionality.
